landmarks.top: Highest fixed chassis edge above cockpit (choose a point on the top edge, excluding shadows).
landmarks.sole: Lowest edge of a planted toe/sole, excluding its shadow.
landmarks.cuff: Lower rigid edge of viewer-right forearm cuff above exposed wrist.
landmarks.apron: Bottom edge of the narrow center plate between thighs, near its centerline.
landmarks.elbow: Viewer-right elbow hinge center; mark null if the axis is hidden.
landmarks.wrist: Viewer-right wrist swivel center; mark null when the center cannot be located within the stated error.
landmarks.round: Centers of distinct round dark marks inside the lower center-apron pocket. Count only that pocket.
landmarks.vertical_slot: Centers of distinct upright slot-shaped marks inside that pocket. Exclude borders and cast shadows.
landmarks.horizontal_slot: Centers of distinct horizontal slot-shaped marks inside that pocket. Exclude borders and cast shadows.
